> December 1st, 2026

# Patch 7.0: Atlas

> Due to the number of changes and the lack of QA testing within our *very small* development team, we are releasing patch 7.0 as a beta version, closing Ranked games and disabling Elo decay for an expected period of one week, while we work to resolve the major bugs that will almost certainly be discovered. The final version with its official poster (created by the community) is coming soon!

## Megas are back !

Mega Evolutions are making a comeback, now that there are enough of them to provide a sufficient range of synergies. 40 Mega are available for the launch of 7.0

## New Synergy: STELLAR

STELLAR is the 32th and last synergy of Pokemon Auto Chess, and a special one: only unlocked through the new Tera Orb item, or by Terapagos passive. A Stellar Pokémon has no synergies by itself, but is considered to be part of all synergies, and so get all their effects.

## A full late-game overhaul

Pokemon Auto Chess introduces the Atlas, a new tree-based progression system unlocked at stage 20 which gives new paths to explore, more variety for each composition, and a less punishing stage 20 portal. You can now play multiple legendaries in the same team!
